abstract: A 37-year-old nulliparous woman presented with severe vaginal bleeding due to a primary immature teratoma of the uterus (Grade II on the Norris scale). The subsequent hysterectomy specimen showed well-differentiated endometrial adenocarcinoma. Mature glial implants were present on both ovaries and throughout the omentum. Postoperative recovery was uneventful and the patient received a course of pelvic radiotherapy. She has remained well with no evidence of recurrence. Primary benign solid teratoma of the uterus is rare. This appears to be the first reported case of primary immature uterine teratoma.
abstract_ja: 37歳の未経産婦が、子宮原発未熟奇形腫（Norris分類Grade II）による重度の膣出血で受診した。その後の子宮摘出標本では高分化型子宮内膜腺癌が認められた。両卵巣および大網全体に成熟したグリア性インプラントが認められた。術後経過は順調で、骨盤内放射線療法を1コース受けた。再発の徴候はなく良好な状態が続いている。原発性良性充実性子宮奇形腫は稀である。本症例は原発性子宮未熟奇形腫の初めての報告例と思われる。
